recipients.sample_description: 79 real assisted-shot events across 25 of 37 real season games (most recent games sampled, chronological order preserved -- see sources/collect.py).

research_summary.simulation_finding: Under a neutral-scenario role expansion, Jalen Green's simulated assist output rises by 0.51 per game relative to baseline. This is a conditional projection under explicit, disclosed assumptions (see simulation_parameters), not a forecast.

monte_carlo.method: Beta-posterior draws of per-touch rates, propagated through the scenario formula; reproducible via the fixed seed

CONSERVATIVE.assumptions_explanation: Target usage 19.9% vs. current 15.3% (ratio 1.30x, if current usage is positive). With touch elasticity e=0.60, 60% of the proportional role change is assumed to become additional decision touches, giving a touch multiplier H=1.18. Pass tendency is then changed by +10%. Role saturation (k=0.85) retains 80% of baseline efficiency at this touch multiplier, and turnover risk grows by +25% relative to baseline. All of this is SIMULATED -- a conditional projection under these explicit assumptions, never a forecast.

efficiency_retention_used.method: exp(-k * max(0, H-1)) unless explicitly overridden
